profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Airbnb
profile.summary: Software engineer with 9+ years of experience delivering scalable applications on web and mobile that incorporate performance, clean design, and maintainability. Analytical thinker experienced in creative problem-solving and collaborating across teams in a fast-paced, agile environment.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: – Front-end leader working across teams to deliver features that increase revenue/conversion and facilitate delightful cart and checkout experiences for customers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Led a project to suggest product upsells to users in cart, increasing overall site revenue by 6%, or $1.8M annualized
– Creatively sought opportunities to decrease manual engineering effort, such as redesigning the client-server relationship that caused race conditions in checkout, decreasing order total discrepancies, and integrating a session monitoring tool for debugging
– Led the front-end engineering guild, mentored junior engineers, and collaborated with engineering leaders to create a standardized interviewing loop. Frequently conducted interviews for candidates ranging from L2 (junior developer) to L4 (staff engineer).

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
– Built and maintained user-facing environments, features, and components as a member of the server/web team, while considering performance, backwards compatibility, and accessibility
– Delivered a customizable grid for customer data with searching, filtering, and pagination, which sped up users’ configuration time by 10x, and a composable UI component to launch business processes, which has been adopted by 700+ Appian customers
– Mentored junior team members by teaching workshops and pair programming

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: – Designed and implemented a modernized news feed with posting, commenting, and file attachment capabilities, using Appian's proprietary evaluation framework and expressions language (server), alongside React.js (client)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: – Contributed to the effort to overhaul our client-side components from Google Web Toolkit to React.js, including the re-design of a multiple file upload component, user hover card component, multicolumn layouts, and paging and editable grids

positions.title: Software R&D Intern
positions.description:
– Analyzed memory traffic and power consumption of a Galaxy S6 target board using embedded systems
– Built a Django web tool for data analysis using Python and HTML
positions.insights: Skills: Python · Django · Highcharts · Linux · Git

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description:
– Designed and programmed a modem simulator in C++
– Worked as a part of Leidos’ deep sea operations team on TRAPS (Transformation Reliable Acoustic Path System), a DARPA contract to detect submarines using sound frequency grams
– Attained a government clearance

positions.title: Technical Intern
positions.description: Built a mobile application for the management of company assets via barcode scanning, using Titanium Appcelerator for cross-compilation to Android and iOS

positions.title: Programming Instructor
positions.description: Designed the course curriculum and taught fundamental Java programming skills to students in grades 7-11
